acceptanceCriteria.text: `createWorktree`'s own failure path (verification failure after successful `git worktree add`) performs compensating `git worktree remove`/branch deletion, or persists a durable ambiguous-state record that a reconciliation pass can act on.

`startTask`'s post-`createWorktree`-success block (DB activation/lifecycle update) is wrapped so that an exception there also triggers compensating physical cleanup (or the same durable ambiguous-state record).

A fault-injection test forces failure immediately after physical worktree creation (both at `createWorktree`'s own verification step and at the later DB-finalization step) and proves no orphaned physical worktree/branch remains, or that it is recorded for reconciliation.

Given this path is `@deprecated`, evaluate as an alternative to fixing it in place: removing the legacy mutator entirely now that Nawabari is the physical worktree authority, if no remaining caller requires it.

issue.title: fix: compensate physical worktree/branch creation when legacy task start fails
